page.notes: The left column is cut off at its left edge and partly overprinted by show-through, so the first word of many left-column lines is uncertain and marked [?] or left as a fragment. Where a line's first letters are not legible, I have not guessed them. The entry "[?]t.& lib.:" and the line "[?]tes & liberos" are only partly legible. Several numbers in the left column may be misaligned by the scan. The bottom "Pacta" is the catchword and the "Eee 3" is the signature.
